create_CO3DDataset: create a CO3DDataset instance from a root directory with a specified train or test split
load_sequence_CO3DDataset: load a specific CO3D sequence by ID to preload images and compute camera poses
gen_rays_CO3DDataset: generate camera rays for all loaded images with an optional downscaling factor
review_CO3DDataset_indexing: review the CO3DDataset constructor indexing logic that parses frame annotations and caches to NPZ
refactor_CO3DDataset_pose_filtering: refactor the CO3DDataset load_sequence method to adjust the max_pose_dist outlier filtering threshold
